        ai_chance = { base = 100 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_society.1106.alone.cost_tooltip }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_society.1106.alone.consequence_tooltip }
        if = { limit = { ywc_t03_dmg_at_1106 = yes NOT = { ywc_t03_partner_current = yes } } if = { limit = { var:ywc_t03_appeal_paid ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t03_outcome value = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t03_outcome value = 4 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t03_popup_epoch add = 1 } }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_society.1106.wait
        trigger = { ywc_t03_dmg_at_1106 = yes }
        ai_chance = { base = 100 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_society.1106.wait.cost_tooltip }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_society.1106.wait.consequence_tooltip }
        if = { limit = { ywc_t03_dmg_at_1106 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t03_pending value = 1106 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t03_popup_epoch add = 1 } }
    }
}
